news.title: Russia's 'hidden mobilization': The 'expendable' lives fueling Putin's war on Ukraine
news.summary: Erin Ogunkeye is pleased to welcome John Lough, Senior Research Fellow and Head of Foreign Policy & International Partnerships at the New Eurasian Strategies Centre (NEST Centre), He is also an Associate Fellow with the Russia & Eurasia Programme at Chatham House. Lough offers a sobering assessment of the social and strategic dynamics sustaining Russia's invasion of Ukraine. He argues that the Kremlin has disproportionately recruited soldiers from poorer and politically marginalised communities, including ethnic minority regions, where the human cost of the conflict is less likely to generate organised opposition. Many of those recruited, he explains, "have been recruited for a deliberate reason because they were seen, you know, ultimately as lives that were expendable, in other words as cannon fodder."

news.summary: La Comisión Europea ha advertido este miércoles de que los recientes ciberataques contra los sistemas de refrigeración de supermercados y bancos de alimentos de varios países europeos deben servir como una "llamada de atención" sobre la vulnerabilidad de las infraestructuras críticas de la Unión Europea, reclamando además a los Veintisiete y a la Eurocámara que refuercen las medidas de protección europeas para evitar que este tipo de incidentes se repitan.

news.title: Los líderes europeos abordarán en Dublín las conversaciones de paz para Ucrania y el relevo en el BCE sin Sánchez
